reviews.title: Works great
reviews.comment: I don’t really care for the RGB on the microphone, if I’m honest it’s not really needed, if you use proper mic technique and distance this mic doesn’t pic up pops very harshly. My main use for it is to have a more “studio” look than RGB. Either way it fits perfectly and does minimize pops cause I tested it as well just to see.
reviews.author: Anthony Patino

reviews.title: Works with the original Hyper X QuadCast's too!
reviews.comment:
Solid vacuum sealed pop filter. Was leery about picking this one up because it was advertised for the 𝙃𝙮𝙥𝙚𝙧 𝙓 𝙌𝙪𝙖𝙙𝙘𝙖𝙨𝙩 2. I needed one for the original 𝙃𝙮𝙥𝙚𝙧 𝙓 𝙌𝙪𝙖𝙙𝙘𝙖𝙨𝙩 𝙎 and it seems like it fits like a glove. I prefer this one over the others due to its wider opening at the top for easier mute button access.
I wish I can see the lights through the foam, but I guess it's a small price to pay to keep the audio and microphone clean and clear from plosives. (Plus, I don't really like having those bulky wind screen pop filters.)
